notes: No tuition figure could be quoted for this programme: the only fee information is institution-wide (collegegeld page) and the programme page refers to the collegegeldmeter without an amount, so tuition is left out. No intake dates/start dates are given for the programme itself beyond 'Startdatum September', so the intake entry has all-null dates and is not usable as a dated intake. The 1 May 2027 deadline is quoted but is not stated as being for non-EU/foreign-diploma applicants, so it is provided only as a manual check, not as a fact. Teaching language is Dutch only (the programme is not taught in English); this means a Moroccan applicant will likely also need to meet Dutch language requirements, but the pages do not state such a requirement for this programme.

note.fr: Diplôme requis : havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4. Sans ce diplôme, l'admission reste possible dans certains cas ; vérifiez les conditions complètes.
note.en: Required diploma: havo, vwo or mbo level 4. Without it, admission may still be possible in some cases; check the full conditions.

evidence.quote: Met een havo-, vwo-, of mbo-diploma (niveau 4) ben je direct toelaatbaar.

note.fr: La date limite d'inscription du 1 mai 2027 n'est pas indiquée comme s'appliquant aux candidats internationaux (diplôme étranger) : vérifiez votre propre date limite auprès de Fontys.
note.en: The 1 May 2027 application deadline is not stated as applying to international applicants with a foreign diploma: verify your own deadline with Fontys.
